title: Event wiring from Frappe to Jube, Docling, OpenAleph and yente
scope: Register outbox handlers and enqueue events from real entry points so a submitted claim and uploaded evidence flow to risk/case (Jube), extraction (Docling), entity indexing (OpenAleph/FtM) and screening (yente), with results written back to Frappe records

acceptance.text: Production code enqueues events on claim submission and evidence upload; vati_outbox_handlers registers handlers for Jube risk/case, Docling extraction (record_extraction), OpenAleph ingest and yente review; each handler records service links and correlation IDs

Submitting SYN-001 and SYN-002 on a local site produces a Jube case, extraction records and indexed entities with no manual steps; replay and unavailable-service paths are tested and visible to operators
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Submitting SYN-001 and SYN-002 on a local site produces a Jube case, extraction records and indexed entities with no manual steps; replay and unavailable-service paths are tested and visible to operators

evidence.text: vati_tax.pipeline (ADR-037). Production entry points enqueue in the caller's transaction: doc_events Vati Submission.on_update (runs after the TAX-039 bridge) links every document a sent refund claim refers to (evidence_ids plus schedule rows) to the case as a frappe/Vati Evidence service link, and doc_events Vati Service Link.after_insert enqueues one evidence.received per evidence linked to a case (claim send, officer upload with case_id, later responses). vati_outbox_handlers: case.registered stays the TAX-039 Jube risk and case handler; evidence.received converts the stored original with Docling (submission kept as the outbox effect docling.submit, then resumed) and records the revision through record_extraction as the service identity; extraction.completed and extraction.failed map the case to FtM entities (TAX-036), write new ones to OpenAleph (idempotent effect, Vati Entity Index ledger) and screen parties with yente (Vati Screening Result, unreviewed). Links recorded: jube/case (bridge), docling/conversion_job, docling/extraction (source_event_id = outbox event), openaleph/document. One correlation ID (the case.registered one) is carried by every event of a claim and stored on the ledgers.

Own Frappe stack rsl-taxathon-frappe-087 (fresh verify site on merged branch e073dbc): install and migrate x2 ok; 468 app tests OK; 424 Frappe-free OK; 183 site tests with only 1 error, in reminders/test_reminders_bench.py (TAX-078), which fails the same way on a clean origin/main baseline in the same stack (174 site tests, 2 failures + 1 error), so it predates this task. The 9 new pipeline site tests pass (also run alone: 9 OK). bench execute vati_tax.pipeline.demo.run on the verify site sent SYN-001 and SYN-002 through portal.api.submit_refund_claim with no manual step: 16 outbox events delivered, 0 failing; SYN-001 Jube case 9001, 3/3 extractions success, 9 entities indexed, 2 parties screened; SYN-002 Jube case 9002, 4/4 extractions success, 11 entities indexed, 3 parties screened, 1 candidate. All four services were fakes (no local Jube, Docling, OpenAleph or yente running; Docling/OpenAleph/yente fakes are transports into the real adapters). Bench tests cover replay (redelivered events make no second outward call and write no duplicate rows; re-enqueue replays), unavailable Docling (retry with docling_upstream_status, no effect row left, dead letter after 5 attempts, later steps wait, operator retry recovers), unavailable OpenAleph then yente (ledger kept), unconfigured service and missing service identity (retryable codes), and the operator view pipeline.api.case_status (System Manager only, tenant-scoped, IDs and codes only).

Tests and evidence recorded under criteria 1 and 2 (17 Frappe-free rule tests, 8 integration tests on the real adapters, 9 site tests; ruff, mypy, validate and the Frappe-free suites pass locally). Review PR #243 opened with Keletso and the backend code-owner team requested; conflict check against main and open PR #242 clean.
